editorial.description_en: The blue that appears in a shadow cast on snow — low in chroma, and further round toward violet than the other pale blues here.
editorial.description_ja: 雪の上の影に見える、うすい青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.800, C 0.026, h 262.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 雪 (yuki, snow) + 影 (kage, shadow). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Snow Shadow" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 雪影. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — fuyu-gumo at ΔE00 3.1, ame-zora at ΔE00 4.1, samu-zora at ΔE00 4.6. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.026 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
